---
name: "Accessibility or reading problem"
about: "Report a barrier to reading, navigating, or using the collection."
---

## Page or document

Paste the page address, or name the work and section:

## What were you trying to do?

For example: follow a proof link, read an equation, navigate with a keyboard,
enlarge the text, or use a PDF with a screen reader.

## What got in the way?

Describe what happened and what would have helped. A short description is enough;
you do not need to identify an accessibility standard or propose a fix.

## Details that may help (optional)

Browser, device, zoom level, and any assistive technology you were using:

Steps to reproduce, a screenshot, or an alternative format that would help:

Please share only details you are comfortable posting publicly. A diagnosis or
medical history is not needed.
